newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Av. price of NZ commodity exports rose in Feb - ANZ.
newsitem.headline: Av. price of NZ commodity exports rose in Feb - ANZ.

text.p: The average New Zealand dollar price of New Zealand's commodity exports rose one percent in February following a 0.6 percent fall in January, ANZ Bank said on Tuesday.
ANZ said its commodity price index showed the corresponding average world price of New Zealand's commodity exports also rose one percent in February, compared with a 0.1 percent fall in January.
It said the New Zealand dollar index strengthened slightly to 99.9 in February from 99.0 in January, while the world price index rose to 125 from 123.7 over the same period.
On an annual basis, the New Zealand dollar index recorded an eight percent fall in February while the world price index dropped 3.2 percent.
ANZ said a small improvement in beef prices contributed to the rise in the commodity price index during February.
"Prices for aluminium and butter have both continued to show some improvement after reaching lows at the end of 1996," the bank said.
"Prices for lamb appear to have peaked and are starting to weaken slightly, although remaining considerably higher than a year ago."
